bc7enc_rdo's texture block encoders and decoders, vendored from [richgel999/bc7enc_rdo](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo) commit `b9438627eef73a1157e84201b6fa6eb2ffd6d9f0` (MIT or public domain, see `LICENSE`). It has no releases, so a commit is pinned. Only the BC7 encoder (`bc7enc`), the BC1 to BC5 encoders and decoders (`rgbcx`, with its `rgbcx_table4*.h` tables) and the BC7 decoder (`bc7decomp`) are kept: the rest is its RDO command-line tool.

To update, replace those files and `LICENSE` from the new commit's archive, and change the commit here.
